description: This file manages provider authentication storage, including creating and updating API keys and credentials for various providers, with functions for setting specific provider keys and configurations.

methods.name: upsertProviderApiKeyProfile
methods.description: Creates or updates an authentication profile for a provider with given parameters.

methods.name: createProviderApiKeySetter
methods.description: Returns a function to set API keys for a specific provider, resolving the key if needed.

methods.name: createProviderApiKeySetters
methods.description: Creates multiple provider API key setter functions based on provided specifications.

methods.name: setMinimaxApiKey
methods.description: Sets the API key for the 'minimax' provider with optional profile ID.

methods.name: setCloudflareAiGatewayConfig
methods.description: Configures API key and metadata for Cloudflare AI Gateway.

methods.name: setOpencodeZenApiKey
methods.description: Sets the Opencode Zen API key.

methods.name: setOpencodeGoApiKey
methods.description: Sets the Opencode Go API key.

methods.name: setSharedOpencodeApiKey
methods.description: Helper to set shared Opencode API keys for multiple providers.
